test_title: PYST 30: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper announces a discount of 15% on purchases up to ₹ 1,800 and 17.5% on purchases above ₹ 1,800. Abdul buys 225 pens at ₹ 8 per pen and 4 dozen pencils at ₹ 30 per dozen. Find the amount paid by Abdul.
solution: Given: Discount on shopping upto Rs.1800 = 15% Discount on shopping above Rs.1800 = 17.5% Price of pen = Rs. 8 Price of pencil = Rs. 30 per dozen Concept used: Selling price = Marked Price - (Marked Price × Discount%)
